entries.english: MacLean, Helene née von Tiedemann (1855–1931) / Portrait of sisters and sister-in-law standing and sitting in a garden, full-length group photograph, from left to right: Helene MacLean; Elisabeth (Elise) Thomas née von Tiedemann (1864–1938); Eva von Gerlach née von Tiedemann (1856–1945); sister-in-law Wolfine von Rosenberg Gruczynski née von Gerlach.
